material.description: Resolved. js/host/guest.js is a native node gate and needs no wasm32 guest build, so the missing wasm32 target does not block the peer-scaling measurement. The measurement runs on the green CI tip (build-once job, peer-scaling step, ratio printed) and locally (PASS ratio 0.518 exit 0; --inject-superlinear FAIL ratio 4.501 exit 1). Ceiling: 1.5 per row gap-net-host-peer-scaling.
material.resolution: Blocker closed; measurement runs natively without a wasm32 target.
